Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF
network binding
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00006, RS_CM_00004, RS_CM_00204
⌈

Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF
network binding only supports the field notifier.
Getter or Setter methods are not supported.
